Case No. 50 of 2012 and the appellant was charged under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code who vide order dated 07.10.2024 has been pleased to convict the appellant under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and vide order dated 08.10.2024 sentenced him to undergo R.I. for 10 (ten) years and fine of Rs.20,000/-
and in default Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ) No.439 of 2025(2) dt.10-02-2025 R.I.
for six months under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code."
The present Interlocutory Application has been preferred for condonation of delay of 39 days in filing of the present appeal.

sentences.text: For the reasons assigned in paragraph nos. 3, 4 and 6 and since there is no opposition from the other side, the delay of 39 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.
Mrs. Vaishnavi Singh points out that Ms. Nazia Shabah is actually representing the appellant but her name is appearing on the side of the respondents.

7. Let the Office do the needful and the name of Ms. Nazia Shabah comes under the appellant's side in the cause list.
8. List this case under appropriate heading in its own seriatim.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
